concept: Casual-upscale Mediterranean-Italian fusion restaurant with wood-fired dishes and a warm neighborhood vibe.

reservations.how_to_book: Call the restaurant directly or use the online reservation form on the website.
reservations.note: This demo chatbot cannot make real reservations — it only explains the process.

payment_methods: Cash (in-person only, not available for delivery)

faq.question: Do you have gluten-free options?
faq.answer: We have limited gluten-free options. Please ask our staff for current gluten-free availability.

faq.question: Is there parking available?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a small parking lot behind the building, and street parking is also available.

faq.question: Do you accommodate large groups?
faq.answer: Yes, groups larger than 8 are welcome with advance notice.
